row.team_price_text: Essentials: price not published (pricing page blocked automated access)
row.evidence: Check Point's SASE admin guide says 'SCIM based user provisioning is available to SASE Enterprise customers only', with SCIM integrations documented for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
row.notes: Check Point is a multi-product vendor; this row covers Harmony SASE (formerly Perimeter 81), the per-member SaaS product with SCIM. The Infinity Portal (account console for other Check Point SaaS) is SAML SSO with JIT only (Okta OIN app checks SAML only; Entra tutorial says JIT). SCIM gate comes from the SASE docs (Enterprise only); sase.checkpoint.com/pricing returned an empty bot challenge to curl, the renderer and WebFetch, so plan prices were not verified and the licensing doc ('contact your Check Point sales representative') is used as the pricing evidence. Default plan is Essentials. Okta SCIM requires the Okta SAML app first. SCIM base URL is regional (https://api.perimeter81.com/api/scim for US). Deleting a user in the IdP removes them from the console and frees the licence. Public API v3 (SwaggerHub) also creates, lists and deletes users and manages group membership.

plans.price_text: Contact Sales (purchase through a Check Point sales representative)

scim.base_url: https://api.perimeter81.com/api/scim (US); https://api.eu.sase.checkpoint.com/api/scim (EU); also AU and IN regional hosts

auth.token_source: SASE Administrator Portal > Settings > Identity Providers > SCIM Integration > Settings > Generate Token (Entra: Microsoft Azure AD provider > Settings > Generate Token)

deprovision.notes: Deleting the user in the IdP removes the user from the SASE console; Okta 'Deactivate Users' is the documented Okta action.

attributes.notes: Entra mapping: userName <- mail, emails[work] <- userPrincipalName, nickName <- objectId (matching precedence 1); delete all other default mappings.

limitations.text: SCIM integration is documented only for Okta and Microsoft Entra ID.
Users previously provisioned through another IdP must be removed individually before enabling Okta SCIM, otherwise deactivation and sync fail.

auth.notes: Key Permissions are selected per key; available permissions depend on account features.

user_api.notes: SwaggerHub spec 3.0.1 also has POST/GET /v3/groups, DELETE /v3/groups/{id} and DELETE /v3/groups/{groupId}/member/{userId}.

okta.notes: OIN 'Check Point SASE' app (app id perimeter81) checks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate and Group Push. Separate 'Check Point Infinity Portal' OIN app is SAML only (c28).

entra.notes: Gallery apps (Perimeter 81, Check Point Harmony Connect, Check Point Infinity Portal) are SAML with JIT; SCIM uses a separately created Entra application pointed at the SCIM URL with a bearer token.

google.notes: Google Workspace sign-in via a custom SAML app or Google Services; no SCIM.

onelogin.notes: Check Point's own OneLogin guide is SAML; OneLogin is not among the SCIM IdPs.

jumpcloud.notes: Check Point's own JumpCloud guide is SAML; JumpCloud is not among the SCIM IdPs.

fallbacks.other_sync: On-premises Active Directory/LDAP connection; Google Services (OAuth with Admin SDK) sign-in
